message:
How to Plan a Wedding in 6 Months, Month by Month

Six months is plenty; you just decide faster.
• Month 1: lock budget, guest count, venue and the one-per-day vendors.
• Month 2: order attire and book the rest.
• Months 3–4: invitations, menu tasting and rings.
• Month 5: chase RSVPs and confirm every vendor.
• Month 6: final headcount and fitting.
